title: Degree and superlative
description: The superlative (一番 ADJ), no less ADJ than NP (NPに劣らず ADJ), and more N1 than N2 (N2より N1の方が多い).

cases.sentence: she is the happiest in her class .
cases.expect: 彼女は彼女のクラスで一番幸せだ。

cases.sentence: he is no less kind than his sister .
cases.expect: 彼は姉に劣らず優しい。
cases.note: the possessive coreferent with the subject is dropped in the comparison phrase as it is for the object (suite B, test 155)

cases.sentence: there are more girls than boys in our school .
cases.expect: 私たちの学校には少年より少女の方が多い。
